sources_read.section: where a persisted flag can live
task 036's seam and its transform-only rule
§4 the three leaf kinds, §5 where state lives

scope: One container leaf plus a persisted flag and stable test ids. Out of scope: per-workspace scoping, a replay control, and any tour copy beyond plain product language.

acceptance_criteria.text: Seven steps, each spotlighting a real element or centred.
tourSeen persists outside `ui` (I16); finishing and skipping both set it.
The hole moves via a CSS-transitioned clip-path; the ring and card move via Motion; reduced motion disables both.
verify green; a live run opens, walks, finishes, and stays closed after a reload.

open_questions: Whether the tour should replay on demand (a header control) or stay one-shot; today only signing out resets it.
risks: A persisted boolean in the workspace slice is reset by signedOut — a returning account sees the tour once per sign-in. Accepted, and recorded.
The target may not exist yet when a step starts (the PDF canvas mounts late); the measurement retries.
A hidden tab freezes CSS transitions and Motion springs alike, so neither may be the only thing that makes a step legible.
